name: Claude Code
removalRules: Conversations, memories, attachments, file history, installed versions, and other files stay protected. Linked Git worktrees use the existing review controls.
note: The native installers keep each installed version in `versions`. `~/.local/bin` links to the active one.

storage.name: Claude Code data

section.title: Task data
section.summary: Conversations, memories, attachments, and recovery files.

storage.explanation: Credentials, settings, memories, and session files remain protected. Claude Code purge also deletes memories.

storage.name: Claude Code sessions and memories
storage.explanation: Conversations, child sessions, tool results, and persistent memories share this folder. Moppo keeps the whole folder protected.

storage.name: Claude Code agent memories
storage.explanation: Persistent agent memories remain protected. These files can be shared across sessions.

storage.name: Claude Code file history
storage.explanation: Saved file versions support checkpoint recovery. Moppo keeps these files protected.

storage.name: Claude Code pasted text
storage.explanation: Saved pasted text can contain session content. The cache name does not make it disposable.

storage.name: Claude Code saved images
storage.explanation: Earlier Claude Code versions stored attached images here. These files can be the only local copies.

storage.name: Claude Code uploaded files
storage.explanation: Files and photos attached to local sessions. These files can be the only local copies.

storage.name: Claude Code versions
storage.explanation: The native installer keeps the installed Claude Code versions here. Moppo keeps them protected.
